about: Organized and reliable Virtual Assistant with over 5 years of experience supporting e-commerce operations, order fulfillment, and supplier coordination for Shopify and WooCommerce stores. I specialize in keeping product catalogs clean, inventory accurate, and customer communication timely. Having worked with teams in Australia, Canada, and the Philippines, I bring strong written English, calm problem-solving under pressure, and a genuine interest in making online stores run smoothly from the back end.

experience.description: Supporting daily store operations for an Australia-based Shopify brand, covering fulfillment, supplier follow-up, and customer service.
details: Process and track daily orders across Shopify and third-party fulfillment partners
Coordinate directly with suppliers for restocks, delays, and quality issues
Respond to customer inquiries via email and live chat within a 2-hour SLA
Maintain accurate inventory counts and flag low-stock items weekly
Prepare monthly summary reports on order volume, refunds, and support tickets

experience.description: Handled product listings, catalog upkeep, and general administrative support for a small e-commerce team.
details: Uploaded and formatted new product listings with accurate descriptions and pricing
Organized product categories and collections for easier customer navigation
Managed the shared inbox and calendar for two team leads
Assisted with basic bookkeeping entries and expense tracking

experience.description: Delivered phone and chat-based support for a US retail account, focused on order issues and account inquiries.
details: Handled inbound calls and chats regarding orders, refunds, and shipping delays
Maintained a customer satisfaction score above 92% across tenure
Escalated complex cases to team leads with clear documentation
Trained 4 newly hired agents on internal tools and call procedures

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Office Administration
